change: A wrong pick in which-slope-fits-best is checked one point at a time, without writing the two sums that give the slope away.

mutations.name: the check writes both sums, which hands over the slope
mutations.replace: they add to Σ(x − x̄)(y − ȳ) − ${this.pf(v)} × Σ(x − x̄)² = ${this.fs(M.sxy)} − ${this.pf(v)} × ${this.fs(M.sxx)} = ${this.fs(K)}

mutations.name: a point's miss leaves out the slope
a point's miss is taken from (0, 0), not the middle point
the x gap is x, not x − x̄
a fraction is not bracketed in a product
the terms are joined by times
the check is played with the sums written
mutations.replace: they give ${this.terms(S,v)}, which is Σ(x − x̄)(y − ȳ) − ${this.pf(v)} × Σ(x − x̄)², = ${this.fs(K)}
